title: SceneCrafter: Controllable Multi-View Driving Scene Editing

output_modality.value: multi-view images (8 surrounding cameras, 512x512) edited from real source images; teacher trained on 17-frame, 8-camera segments

control_signal.value: target weather and time of day, agent boxes (insert or remove by agent type), HD map, camera poses as raymaps, and the source images to edit

control_mechanism.value: Conditions are encoded into the U-Net cross-attention blocks; raymaps, masks and source-image latents are concatenated with noisy latents; Prompt-to-Prompt with self-attention replacement makes paired training data

base_model.value: Pretrained multi-view latent diffusion model (view-spatial joint attention, raymap pose conditioning, 8 views), teacher models then a student editing model

datasets.value: Curated driving-log set of 13,867,496 segments (17 frames, 8 cameras, 10 Hz), 1% held out; 1M synthetic paired samples train the student

metrics.value: FID, CLIP score adapted for controllability, new 3D LPIPS for multi-view consistency, and a user study

controllability_evidence.value: Generation task: full model FID 36.2 and 3D LPIPS 0.187 vs real 11.5 and 0.186; without conditions 68.5 and 0.254; CAT3D 121.3 and 0.249. Concatenation beats cross-attention: CLIP 0.220 vs 0.203

closed_loop.value: No; edits logged multi-view images, no policy rollout reported in the packet

notes: Editing model rather than world model; no limitations section in packet. Table 1 editing comparison with SDEdit and P2P not in packet.
